correctness.rationale: The only structural input is the degree-one-endpoint characterization of minimal edge covers, checked directly. Every maximal-size support is a two-star forest: if both sides have at least three, removing a chosen leaf edge forces a redundant retained edge; with a side of size two, a trace omitting an entire center star forces redundant overlap. For the lower bound explicit a=2 assignments and an a,b≥3 three-star support realize every trace; all case-specific added edges have a degree-one endpoint. The construction and independent exhaustive small-case enumerations replayed successfully, but universal validity is established by the written proof, not finite tests.

value.rationale: A sharp exact two-parameter VC-dimension classification for a standard inclusion-minimal graph covering class, with a structural loss of one against the largest concept size. It constructs all Boolean traces on an explicit canonical three-star support, useful to learning-theoretic and combinatorial study of inclusion-minimal solutions. This is not merely the known maximum-edge-cover bound or a small-instance table.
